reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named lab with the report for my batch plus a money-back guarantee takes most of the risk out. At $24.99 for one box I'd try it once and see if I even notice anything.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others put several forms in one capsule? And I still think most supplements are a waste unless my doctor backs it.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me to skip it or a blood test showing my magnesium is fine would flip it to a no.
